verdict.line: You lose if you swing autos into an up Counter Strike; you win if you bait E down first and close with W or E-stun into R.

brief.thesis: This is a genuinely even lane at 51.3% over 557 games, but the edge splits by phase: Jax owns the solo-kill window because Counter Strike (E) punishes any auto-reliant trade, while Sett's HP-percent tools (W, R) don't care whether he dodges with E or not. The lane is won or lost on whether you fight around his E cooldown instead of through it.

theirWindow.when: Jax's E and both W charges are up
theirWindow.what: Do not initiate with Q (Knuckle Down) autos here — he dodges the combo with Counter Strike and stuns you for the double Empowered hit. Hold range, let him spend E on a minion or a whiff before you commit.

yourWindow.when: Jax's E is down or he's used it on wave
yourWindow.what: This is your all-in window. Land E (Facebreaker) for the stun, then full W (Haymaker) release or R (The Show Stopper) — none of it can be dodged once E is on cooldown.

start.why: Measured 50.3% WR over 527 games and the overwhelming pick (76.4%) — the extra sustain and damage let you contest early trades without needing to land E first.

boots.why: Higher measured win rate (56.7% vs 48.3% for Plated Steelcaps) — the tenacity shortens how long his E stun and R slow lock you down, which matters more than the armor since his early damage is burst-Empower, not sustained auto pressure.

core.why: The most popular and highest-winrate path (70.8% over 89 games) — the slow-on-hit and mobility let you actually stick to his Leap Strike (Q) resets instead of chasing on cooldown.
Follows Stridebreaker in the top build path; the armor shred speeds up trades once you've forced his E down and are fighting through his passive attack speed stacks.
Rounds out the top path at 70.8% WR — the max-HP scaling directly buffs your W and R damage, which are both percent-HP based.

situational.when: he is building lethal burst around double-Empower autos and you need the shield to survive his all-in
you are ahead and want faster W charges and E cooldown to chain more all-ins per recall
the game goes long and you need raw HP to keep your R and W numbers scaling in extended fights

runes.keystoneWhy: Both measured rune pages run Conqueror — the sustained adaptive force and healing amp reward you for holding through Jax's E timer instead of disengaging, which is exactly the pattern this lane rewards.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 88.8% of games at 52.5% WR — Ignite punishes the exact all-in windows described above once his E is down and he can't heal off the trade, converting your stun combo into a kill instead of just a shove.

playing.title: Bait E before all-in
playing.detail: Never lead with Q (Knuckle Down) autos while his E is up — he dodges the combo with Counter Strike and stuns you for free. Force him to spend it on a poke or minion first.

playing.title: Charge W through his E
playing.detail: W (Haymaker) is not a basic attack, so it still connects even during his Counter Strike window — use it to grab priority instead of trading autos into a dodge.

playing.title: All-in before level 6
playing.detail: His R (Grandmaster's Might) grants stun immunity, so your R (The Show Stopper) grab is strongest pre-6 — after that, expect his all-ins to shrug off your CC entirely.

playing.title: Track his Empower charges
playing.detail: Jax's W stacks two charges of bonus damage; once both are visibly spent on a leap or auto, he's out of burst and you can safely shove or extend the trade.

playing.title: Land E stun before committing
playing.detail: Prioritize E (Facebreaker) at level 3 — Q into E stun lands your full W or R cleanly whenever his Counter Strike is already on cooldown.

playing.title: Extend trades with your passive heal
playing.detail: Your passive heals for a percentage of damage dealt to champions below 50% HP — stay in the fight past his stun window instead of backing off, since your sustain outlasts his cooldowns.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, sample sizes, build paths, runes, and summoner spells above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the timing reads, combo interactions, and trade patterns are my own tactical judgment applied to that data.

stats.opponentTip: Use [W] when Jax uses (Q)-(E) to gain the upper hand. Fight him often before he has a chance to grow in order to gain lane control.
